content.title: Anaemia, moderate
content.body: Uploaded CBC reports haemoglobin 9.2 g/dL against a normal range above 12, consistent with moderate anaemia. Screening-grade platform output; requires clinical confirmation. Recommend urgent haematology review and iron studies. Patient counselled to consult a physician within 3 days.
recommendations: Order iron studies and ferritin within 3 days.
Refer to haematology for urgent review.
